title: Stable Text Anchor 0.1
description: A quotation bound to a code-point range in the STA-C14N form of a text identified by its SHA-256. The profile fields are fixed in version 0.1 and are present so that no reader has to assume them.

unit.description: Offsets count Unicode scalar values, never bytes, UTF-16 code units or grapheme clusters.

form.description: Offsets and the hash are taken on NFC text.

newline.description: CRLF and lone CR were folded to LF before counting.

bom.description: A single leading U+FEFF was removed before counting.

text_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the UTF-8 encoding of the whole canonical text.

start.description: Code-point offset of the first selected character; inclusive.

end.description: Code-point offset after the last selected character; exclusive. end - start equals the code-point length of exact.

exact.description: The selected text in canonical form; the second witness.

prefix.description: Up to a few dozen code points before start, for quote-only resolution.

suffix.description: Up to a few dozen code points after end.

source.description: Identifier or IRI of the text, when known.
